title: Bias and fairness: the protected attribute you left out and the proxy you kept

videos.script: The churn model hands out a forty real credit. Some people get it and some do not. {{credit}} Split the test months by age, and the youngest leave most and get the most credits. The oldest leave almost as often and get the fewest. {{bands}} Take age out of the model, the first thing anybody suggests. The young lose credits, and the model still tells the bands apart. {{unaware}} The columns that stay pick out the over sixty-fives without being told anybody's age, and two of them, the app and the boleto, change sharply with it. {{proxies}} Three definitions of fair, and a theorem that says you cannot have all of them. {{measures}} Equal shares for every band, priced in reais. {{price}} And four things people will say about all this, with a reply to each. {{reply}} By the end, you can audit a model by group, and you know which part of fairness is a decision rather than a number. {{end}}
